text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Spin-off! Spin-off!! BUN! Company song! 
Company song! Company song!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I am a traveling minstrel!! I shall 
forcibly bestow upon you a song 
celebrating your birth!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
And to the passing gambler over there. 
I've prepared a special game just for you 
today.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
You and I each put up some fingers with 
one hand. If the total is 3, good fortune 
awaits. Anything else means ruin... Heh 
heh, what'll it be?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"You wish to challenge me? Such audacious 
courage. Fascinating. I shall entertain 
this diversion."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Still, before our contest, I must ask. 
Should good fortune smile upon us, will 
you delight me with a banquet befitting 
the occasion?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I swear it. I know full well what 
flavors you like and how you like to eat.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Spin-off! Spin-off! Company song! Company 
song! Company song! Company song!—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Then all is well. Now then—
